topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: When I saw the stump today, all I could think about was that sunny day I planted the tree. I was so young, and it was just a small sapling. Over the years, I watched it grow, like a silent witness to my own life. It was more than a tree; it was a part of me. I wish I had been there, could have done something. Maybe if I had known, things would be different. I keep replaying the moments we spent together, under its branches. It felt like a betrayal, a loss. I can't bring myself to look at the stump anymore.
